name: sticky-list
description: Solution list: a heading that sticks beside rows of capabilities, each row a coloured left rule with an icon, a title and a checklist. Live: the `.ap-features` section on every vertical and the numbered variant on the solution pages.

title.description: Heading beside the rows. Line breaks are kept.

items.description: Each may carry num (a numeral shown instead of the icon). Rows. Each: title (required); optional icon (URL), icon_svg (inline SVG), icon_alt, accent (hex colour for the rule and check marks), checks (array of strings), body, link_label and link_url.

lede.description: Supporting paragraph under the sticky heading.

variant.description: solution: the industry hubs' and solution pages' feature list (item headings at line-height 1.3).

head_space.description: Space above and below the heading per step, in px, keyed 1024, 991, 768, 560, each [top, bottom] (live Police: its own 991px step). Leave empty for the shared spacing.

stack.description: Width at which the layout stacks: 1024px (the hubs) or 900px (the Education hub).
